title: raven rtr monitor NDJSON, schema_version 1
description: One NDJSON line: one record. The record type is event_type. See docs/reference/telemetry-ndjson.md. Within schema_version 1 changes are additive only; consumers must ignore fields and record types they do not know. This schema lists exactly what version 1 emits, and is strict (additionalProperties false) so that RAVEN's own tests catch drift: a consumer validating with it must allow for additions.

connected.description: A TCP (or TLS) connection to the cache was opened and the first query is about to be sent.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Records written before it existed have none.

timestamp.description: When the event happened: RFC 3339 with up to nanosecond precision and a UTC offset, which consumers must honor. RAVEN writes UTC (Z); files from older releases may carry the host's local offset.

cache.description: The RTR cache, as given to --cache (host:port).

event_type.description: A TCP (or TLS) connection to the cache was opened and the first query is about to be sent.

proto_version.description: RTR protocol version of the session (on connected and version_downgrade: the version asked for). 0 carries no ASPA.

disconnected.description: A session that connected has ended. Exactly one per connected.

error_text.description: RAVEN's description of the failure; absent on shutdown. Not stable, do not parse.

sync.description: A sync completed: the cache sent End of Data.

event_type.description: A sync completed: the cache sent End of Data.

serial.description: The cache's serial from End of Data. Always present, 0 included (older files omit it when 0).

serial_changed.description: The serial differs from the previous sync's (true on the first).

vrp_total.description: VRPs held after the sync (duplicate announcements counted). Always present, 0 included.

vrp_announced.description: VRP announcement PDUs in this sync. Always present, 0 included.

vrp_withdrawn.description: VRP withdrawal PDUs in this sync. Always present, 0 included.

aspa_total.description: ASPA records (customer ASes) held after the sync. Always present, 0 included.

aspa_announced.description: ASPA announcement PDUs in this sync. Always present, 0 included.

aspa_withdrawn.description: ASPA withdrawal PDUs in this sync. Always present, 0 included.

sync_duration_ns.description: Nanoseconds from sending the query to receiving End of Data. Always present.

interval_since_ns.description: Nanoseconds since the previous sync's End of Data in this process. Absent on the first sync and when 0.

reset.description: The cache sent a Cache Reset; a full sync follows.

error.description: The cache sent an Error Report that is a fault: any code but 2, and code 4 on an established session, at version 0 or at a pinned version; the session ends. Or, with error_origin client, RAVEN found a protocol error in what the cache sent during a sync (code 7: a record announced again while held; code 6: a record withdrawn that was not held). RAVEN keeps a count per record, so the cache's intended state holds, and resyncs with a Reset Query on the same session; the session goes on.

cache_not_ready.description: The cache sent Error Report code 2 (No Data Available): it is still starting. Not a fault; retried at the same version.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Records written before it existed have none.

timestamp.description: When the event happened: RFC 3339 with up to nanosecond precision and a UTC offset, which consumers must honor. RAVEN writes UTC (Z); files from older releases may carry the host's local offset.

cache.description: The RTR cache, as given to --cache (host:port).

event_type.description: The anomaly detector flagged the previous record (a sync, a reset or an error).

trigger.description: structural: cache_reset, error_report, or protocol_error (an error with error_origin client). statistical: the metric that tripped the hard threshold, or the metrics that crossed the soft threshold joined with + (a correlated trip).

severity.description: high: structural, or a hard threshold. medium: a correlated trip.

z_scores.description: Statistical only: modified z (unitless) of each metric at or above its soft threshold.

raw.description: Statistical only: every metric's value in the sync (ns for *_ns, counts otherwise).

divergence.description: The cache has persistently disagreed with the other compared caches (longer than the settle window): a divergence episode began. One per episode, not per item.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Records written before it existed have none.

timestamp.description: When the event happened: RFC 3339 with up to nanosecond precision and a UTC offset, which consumers must honor. RAVEN writes UTC (Z); files from older releases may carry the host's local offset.

cache.description: The cache the episode is at, as given to --cache (host:port).

event_type.description: The cache has persistently disagreed with the other compared caches (longer than the settle window): a divergence episode began. One per episode, not per item.

episode.description: The episode's number at this cache, from 1, in this process.

started_at.description: When the episode's earliest difference first appeared, in its current shape (the compared caches and who held it).

compared.description: The caches compared when the record was written, in --cache order: those connected that have completed a sync in their current session.

settle_ns.description: The settle window in effect, in nanoseconds: a difference counts once it has lasted longer.

counts.description: Persistent differences attributed to the cache, by kind; only kinds with at least one.

samples.description: Up to 20 of the persistent differences, taken from each kind in turn, sorted by kind and item.

prefix.description: The VRP's prefix, as the cache sent it (address/length).

providers.description: ASPA kinds: the cache's provider set, sorted; absent when it has none.

majority_providers.description: ASPA kinds: the majority's provider set, sorted; absent on aspa_split and when the majority has none.

agree.description: The compared caches that hold what this cache holds for the item, it included.

disagree.description: The compared caches that do not.

split_with.description: When counts has a split kind: the caches on the other side of the split items.

divergence_resolved.description: A divergence episode ended: the cache no longer disagrees with the other compared caches on anything.
